name: Betting Odds tab is reachable and activatable by keyboard
description: The Odds tab must be operable without a mouse: focusable via keyboard and activatable with Enter or Space, revealing the odds content. A tab that only responds to mouse clicks is inaccessible.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage and open a match detail page
Use the keyboard (Tab key) to move focus to the Betting Odds tab in the tab navigation, then press Enter or Space to activate it

Verify the Betting Odds tab can receive keyboard focus (shows a visible focus indicator) and that activating it via the keyboard reveals the odds content with the per-book table and consensus row. If the tab cannot be focused or activated without a mouse, the test fails.
